%function(self)
self:x(132) self:y(-7) self:zoom(.2) self:zoomx(.25) self:horizalign('left') self:shadowlength(1) self:rotationy(-3) self:rotationz(-1) end

Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) self:zoom(0.18) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) if PROFILEMAN:GetMachineProfile():GetSongNumTimesPlayed(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong()) > 0 then self:settext( THEME:GetMetric('PaneDisplay', 'Played')..PROFILEMAN:GetMachineProfile():GetSongNumTimesPlayed(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong()) ) else self:settext( THEME:GetMetric('PaneDisplay', 'NeverPlayed') ) self:diffusetopedge(1,0,1,1) self:diffusebottomedge(0,1,1,1) end self:decelerate(0.1) else self:hidden(1) end self:zoom(0.3) self:diffusealpha(1) end

Layer.OnCommand:
%function(self)
self:x(140) self:y(-10) self:zoom(.2) self:horizalign('left') self:shadowlength(1) self:maxwidth(SCREEN_WIDTH/1.5) self:rotationy(-4.5) self:rotationz(-1) end
Layer.UpdateStartCommand: %function(self) self:finishtweening() self:accelerate(0.1) self:zoom(0.18) self:diffusealpha(0) self:sleep(0.001) self:queuecommand('Update') end
Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) self:zoom(0.18) local panep1=SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PaneDisplayP1') local panep2=SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PaneDisplayP2') if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() and (panep1 or panep2) then local scoretxt1 = '0.00%' local scoretxt2 = '0.00%' if panep1 then scoretxt1 = panep1:GetChild(''):GetChild('MachineHighScoreText'):GetText() end if panep2 then scoretxt2 = panep2:GetChild(''):GetChild('MachineHighScoreText'):GetText() end self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) self:settext( THEME:GetMetric('PaneDisplay', 'HighScore')..scoretxt1..' / '..scoretxt2 ) self:decelerate(0.1) else self:hidden(1) end self:zoom(0.3) self:diffusealpha(1) end

%function(self) MESSAGEMAN:Broadcast('UpdateSortOrder') self:y(30) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist()) self:decelerate(0.1) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds() >= 3600 then self:settext(SecondsToHHMMSS(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds())) else self:settext(SecondsToMMSS(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds())) end else self:hidden(1) end self:y(20) self:diffusealpha(1) end

Layer.CurrentStepsP1ChangedMessageCommand: %function(self) if IsEasierDifficulty(PLAYER_1) then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end end
%function(self) if IsHarderDifficulty(PLAYER_1) then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end end

Layer.CurrentStepsP2ChangedMessageCommand: %function(self) if IsEasierDifficulty(PLAYER_2) then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end end
%function(self) if IsHarderDifficulty(PLAYER_2) then self:hidden(0) else self:hidden(1) end end
